Results: The net benefit over ten years, as a present value. Mean of the 1,000 draws, and the low and high ends of the interval the Guide sets.
Sensitivity: Which inputs move each result most (how each number is found: the Guide)
Noise line: a key below it is likely chance, and its rank shows blank. An approximate guide: on fat-tailed outputs an input with no effect clears this line about one run in ten.
